rules:
The first line contains two integers n, m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100) — the number of streets and avenues in Munhattan.

Each of the next n lines contains m integers cij (1 ≤ cij ≤ 109) — the cost of the dinner in the restaurant on the intersection of the i-th street and the j-th avenue. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
